players.product: Apple Silicon (A19 / A19 Pro, M5) — leading-edge logic on TSMC N2/N3

quarterly_data.signal: Apple announced HomePod mini 2 on October 13, 2026, powered by the Apple S10 chip; Siri AI is coming to HomePod mini 2 'in a future software update' (English, in the U.S., Australia, Canada, India, New Zealand, Singapore, South Africa and the UK), and with the new Apple TV 4K (4th generation) users can create a four-speaker surround sound setup for the first time. Pre-orders started October 13 in the U.S. and more than 23 other countries and regions, with availability in stores beginning October 30, at $149 (U.S.).
